name: Teen Volunteers (Fulton County Library System)
org: Fulton County Library System (Atlanta-Fulton Public Library)
what_you_do: Help library branches with 1 to 2 hour shifts. Tasks include shelving and clerical work. They also include crowd control at events and helping the Friends of the Library. Some branches have Teen Advisory Boards.
who_can_apply: Youth under 18 may apply with a parent or guardian signature. The page does not state a minimum age, so ask Volunteer Services.
deadline_text: Applications are always accepted, but most projects are full and most locations have a waitlist.
how_to_apply: The page (last updated 2026/10/07) says most volunteer projects are filled. Most places have a waitlist. You can still apply. Under 18: download and print the PDF application, sign it, get a parent or guardian signature, and return it to Volunteer Services by email, mail, fax or drop-off. Then attend orientation. Email vol.services@fultoncountyga.gov or call 404-613-0125.
notes: The page says the library is on hold for community service hour requests. Students who need school hours must contact Volunteer Services early. Some branches have Teen Advisory Boards; ask the Youth Services Librarian. Library systems for DeKalb and Cobb counties are separate.
